title: PE->XEX2 packer + identity round-trip
summary: xex2pack.py packs a PPC PE basefile into an unsigned/unencrypted/uncompressed XEX2-DLL (base 0x84000000, DLL flag, zeroed sig+hashes). Identity round-trip is byte-exact and the output loads through Xenia's real XEX2 loader (full module load + import resolution for xam.xex + xboxkrnl.exe).
proven: PHASE-0 identity round-trip: xex2pack(stock_basefile) -> xex1tool -b recovers a BYTE-IDENTICAL PE for BOTH compression=none and compression=basic (md5 62985ed2e5ab6cad55e00b9390914837).

Container is accepted by Xenia's production XEX2 loader: header/opt-headers/security-info/page-descriptors/uncompressed-basefile all parse; module flags read as DLL (0x9); entry point 0x8401B590 read from opt header; sections mapped; SetupLibraryImports resolves ALL imports for xam.xex + xboxkrnl.exe with zero 'unimplemented import' errors (using a raw-thunk basefile).
Both compression=none (XexDataFormat::None / raw) and compression=basic (single DataSize/ZeroSize block) load equivalently in Xenia.
Stock XEX2 header layout fully decoded and cross-checked against XenonRecomp xex.h and idaxex xex_structs.hpp; XenonRecomp Xex2SecurityInfo.'unknown'=0x174 identified as HvImageInfo.InfoSize.

stock_dll_facts.static_libraries: XAPILIB, XBOXKRNL, XNET, XONLINE, LIBCMT, LINK, C2, C1 (build-time only, NOT XEX import libs)
stock_dll_facts.note_for_lane_L: Only TWO real XEX import libraries resolve at load: xam.xex and xboxkrnl.exe. All NetDll_* / Xam* symbols are ordinals in xam.xex; Nt*/Rtl*/Ke*/XeCrypt*/Xex* are ordinals in xboxkrnl.exe. Exact ordinals dumped in handoff.

key_findings: idaxex `xex1tool -b` dumps a POST-import-rewrite basefile: read_imports() overwrites every function thunk in-place with li r3,moduleidx (0x38600000|idx) / li r4,ordinal (0x38800000|ord). A packer fed that image produces a container whose thunks decode as record_type=0x38 -> Xenia SetupLibraryImports assert_always at xex_module.cc:1386. deidax_thunks.py reverses this (word0 -> 0x01000000|ordinal) to yield the RAW basefile the loader expects. A from-source PE (link.exe output) already has raw thunks, so this restore step is only needed for the idaxex round-trip source.

Xenia halts after full module load at XThread::GetCurrentThread assert (xthread.cc:117, 'kernel stuff from a non-kernel thread'). This is the harness limit of launching a game-injected DLL as a standalone title in headless mode, NOT a packer/container defect.

Zeroed RSA signature + all HV digests (image/import/header/section) are intentional and benign: idaxex prints 'Invalid ... hash' but still fully parses; RGH/devkit loaders skip HV hash validation. No free tool can mint a retail-signed XEX (accepted, per spec).
remaining: Hardware boot on the physical RGH console via RB3ELoader is untested here (no console access in this environment).

From-scratch import-table SYNTHESIS (build the IMPORT_LIBRARIES opt block from Lane L's ordinal .def rather than copying the stock block) is stubbed via --import-block but not yet generated from ordinals; wire once Lane L lands.

Packer currently sources entry-point/imports/pe-name from --from-xex for the round-trip; the from-source path (Phase 4) must pass --entry (PE AddressOfEntryPoint+base) and --import-block from the linker output.
Choose final compression mode for hardware: both none and basic pass Xenia; recommend BASIC (matches what xextool '-e u' emits and is the most widely accepted 'uncompressed' encoding).
